desc: 3 组客户同名同城，ID 带 -DUP，均标正常
detect_sql: SELECT customer_name, COUNT(*) c FROM dim_customer GROUP BY customer_name HAVING c>1;
expect: 指标若按客户名去重/计数会偏大

desc: 约 15% 客户 city 写作『杭州市』等带市后缀
detect_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM dim_customer GROUP BY city ORDER BY 2 DESC;
expect: 按 city 分组会分裂成两个值

desc: 同名产品存在多个 product_id（不同带宽/价格）
detect_sql: SELECT product_name, COUNT(*) c FROM dim_product GROUP BY product_name HAVING c>1;
expect: 按产品名 JOIN 会放大行数

desc: 约 3% 客户 customer_level 为 NULL
detect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_customer WHERE customer_level IS NULL;
expect: 按等级分组需处理 NULL 桶

detect_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM fact_order WHERE order_date > date('now');
expect: 时间窗口统计需排除异常日期

desc: 约 2.4% first_response_at 为空、3% resolved_at 为空
detect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_ticket WHERE first_response_at IS NULL;
expect: 平均响应时长计算需排除 NULL

type: SLA 标记与时长不一致
desc: 约 0.8% 工单 sla_flag 与 (resolved-created)<=4h 矛盾
detect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_ticket WHERE (sla_flag='N' AND (julianday(resolved_at)-julianday(created_at))*24<=4) OR (sla_flag='Y' AND (julianday(resolved_at)-julianday(created_at))*24>4);
expect: 以标记为准还是以时长为准，属口径歧义

desc: 8 行 limit 金额被改动 3.33 元
detect_sql: SELECT b.bill_month, b.order_id, b.amount_due, ROUND(o.monthly_fee*o.discount_rate + b.adjustment,2) calc FROM fact_bill b JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id=b.order_id WHERE ABS(b.amount_due - (ROUND(o.monthly_fee*o.discount_rate,2)+b.adjustment))>0.01 LIMIT 20;

desc: 约 6% 账单 adjustment 为负
detect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_bill WHERE adjustment<0;
expect: 营收口径需说明是否含调整

desc: 5 个订单在退订月份仍有账单
detect_sql: SELECT b.bill_month,b.order_id,o.cancel_date FROM fact_bill b JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id=b.order_id WHERE o.cancel_date IS NOT NULL AND b.bill_month >= substr(o.cancel_date,1,7) LIMIT 20;
expect: 『在网收入』口径需明确是否按月过滤
